name: vadimgaidai
description: React Harness for Claude Code: convention skills plus a structure plugin (feature folders or Feature-Sliced Design) make Claude write React applications in one structure on a plain request, with manual spec-driven stages and an automatic loop on top

plugins.name: react-harness
plugins.description: The core of React Harness for Claude Code: a hook that routes every session to nine convention skills (React 19, TanStack Query, shadcn/ui, forms, routing, TypeScript, error handling, code shape, testing), so a plain request comes out in one structure and style. Optional stages started by you: spec, plan, implement, verify, review, refine, and autopilot for a hook-driven verify → refine → review loop. Pair with feature-folders or feature-sliced-design; add a design plugin for the look.

plugins.name: feature-sliced-design
plugins.description: The structure plugin of React Harness for Feature-Sliced Design: a skill that answers layer and import questions, a module scaffolder, and hooks that reject a misplaced file, a wrong filename, an upward or sideways import, or model content in the wrong place before it is written, not in review after.

plugins.name: feature-folders
plugins.description: The structure plugin of React Harness for projects without layers: a features/<name>/ module per domain area, an api/<resource>/ folder per backend resource, pages that only compose, plus global buckets. A skill answers local or global, a scaffolder creates a module, and a hook refuses a new file outside the structure, a wrong filename, or model content (a type, a constant, a schema, a hook, an HTTP call) in a UI file. Placement and naming block new files only, so a legacy project stays untouched.
